title: Steer2Edit: From Activation Steering to Component-Level Editing
abstract: arXiv:2602.09870v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Steering methods influence Large Language Model behavior by identifying semantic directions in hidden representations, but are typically realized through inference-time activation interventions that apply a fixed, global modification to the model's internal states. While effective, such interventions often induce unfavorable attribute-utility trade-offs under strong control, as they ignore the fact that many behaviors are governed by a small and heterogeneous subset of model components. We propose Steer2Edit, a theoretically grounded, training-free framework that transforms steering vectors from inference-time control signals into diagnostic signals for component-level rank-1 weight editing. translated_title: Steer2Edit：从激活引导到组件级编辑
translated_abstract: 引导方法通过在隐藏表示中识别语义方向来影响大语言模型的行为，但通常是通过推理时的激活干预来实现，即对模型内部状态施加固定的、全局性的修改。虽然有效，但此类干预在强控制下往往会带来不利的属性-效用权衡，因为它们忽略了这样一个事实：许多行为是由模型组件中一个规模小且异构的子集所主导的。我们提出Steer2Edit，一个具有理论基础且无需训练的框架，它将引导向量从推理时的控制信号转变为用于组件级rank-1权重编辑的诊断信号。Steer2Edit不再在生成过程中均匀注入引导方向，而是选择性地在各个注意力头和MLP神经元之间重新分配行为影响，从而产生可解释的编辑，同时保持标准的前向传播路径（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: Steer2Edit提出了一种无需训练的理论框架，将引导向量从推理时的全局控制信号转变为诊断信号，通过在注意力头和MLP神经元之间选择性重新分配行为影响，实现保持模型标准功能的可解释组件级rank-1权重编辑。
en_tdlr: Steer2Edit is a theoretically grounded, training-free framework that transforms steering vectors from inference-time control signals into diagnostic signals for component-level rank-1 weight editing, selectively redistributing behavioral influence across attention heads and MLP neurons to yield interpretable edits while preserving standard model functionality.
